# TenderMaster AI

> AI-powered tender analysis platform for Indian businesses. Upload a government tender document and get eligibility checks, BOQ (Bill of Quantities) extraction and pricing, a bid calculator, bid recommendations, and auto-filled submission documents — in English, Hindi or Gujarati.

TenderMaster AI helps Indian bidders decide whether to bid on a government tender and prepares the paperwork to submit it. It supports tenders from GeM (Government e-Marketplace), CPPP (Central Public Procurement Portal), nProcure and other Indian e-procurement portals.

## Key capabilities

- Tender analysis — eligibility checks, compliance matrix, match score, deadlines and risk assessment extracted from the tender document
- Universal BOQ Engine — detects and extracts the Bill of Quantities (Percentage Rate, Item Rate, or Lump Sum/EPC schedules) with automatic Schedule-B detection and confidence verification
- Smart Financial Engine / bid calculator — price every BOQ item, track margins, and see the total bid value update live
- AI Document Generator — company profile, EMD declaration, technical bid and other submission documents, generated automatically
- Auto-filled annexures — the exact form issued by the tender department, completed with the bidder's business data
- EMD and Security Deposit tracker — Paid → Pending Refund → Refunded
- Multilingual — results and documents available in English, Hindi and Gujarati
